name: WCB Desert Conservation Program
summary: California state grants for acquisition, restoration and management projects in the Mojave and Colorado Deserts, including riparian and upland restoration, invasive plant control and seed propagation. Pre-applications are taken continuously.

steps: Technical review and scoring of the full application
Selection panel recommendation and due diligence
Public WCB Board review and funding decision

eligibility.rule: Project provides protected or restored biodiversity, climate action, or public access to nature
Acquisition is from a willing seller at no more than fair market value
Implementation project has intermediate or advanced design plans

documents: Complete list of assessor’s parcel numbers for projects with more than five

status.quote: The Wildlife Conservation Board accepts pre-applications for acquisition, restoration, and management projects on a continuous basis.

administered_by.quote: Passage of the California Desert Conservation Act established the Desert Conservation Program under the administration of the Wildlife Conservation Board.

applicant_types.quote: Entities eligible to apply for grant funding under the Desert Conservation Program include: federal and state agencies, local public agencies, tribal entities, and non-profits with 501 (c)(3) tax exempt status.

geography.quote: restore the natural, cultural, and physical resources of the portions of the Mojave and Colorado Deserts region in California

access.quote: The Wildlife Conservation Board accepts pre-applications for acquisition, restoration, and management projects on a continuous basis.

window.quote: The Wildlife Conservation Board accepts pre-applications for acquisition, restoration, and management projects on a continuous basis.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost share is not required but may be beneficial, in particular to complete a larger project.

effort.quote: Applicants will first submit a Pre-application.
will invite the selected applicants to submit Full Applications.
All eligible and complete Full Applications will be evaluated and scored by technical reviewers
and will direct staff to conduct due diligence on the applications to assure the project can move forward.
preparation for presentation at a public WCB Board meeting. WCB’s voting members have sole and absolute discretion to approve a project for funding.

eligibility.quote: All projects shall provide one or more of the following benefits, as identified in WCB's Strategic Plan:  Protected or restored biodiversity;  Climate change action; and/or  Expanded public access to nature.
Acquisitions, in the form of conservation easement, water rights, and fee purchases, must be from willing sellers and at a price that does not exceed the fair market value.
Implementation applications must include intermediate or advanced design plans (e.g., design plans at ~65% level of development or higher).

after_award.quote: All grantees doing restoration, development, scientific studies, and planning will be required to provide a final report.
Grantees of the State of California are subject to audit by the Department of Finance, and others.

documents.quote: Upload Project maps, photos, plans, and other relevant documents to help describe your proposal.
